# Workflow comparison

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen_workflow_comparison.py from analysis/v3_validation/protocol.yaml; do not edit. -->

This page lists the five workflow families that the v3 validation protocol compares, with the
strengths and limitations that follow from how each is defined there. It reports **no performance
number and makes no ranking or superiority claim**: the workflow matrix has not been executed
(`workflow_matrix.status: pending`), and a quantitative comparison needs a `validated_v3` artifact.
See the [claim registry](https://github.com/mdmanurung/ViralScan/blob/main/claims/registry.json) entry `cross-tool-superiority`.

| Workflow family | Protocol workflows | Strengths | Limitations |
|---|---|---|---|
| ViralScan combined | `W1_viralscan_combined` (primary, 12 datasets) | The primary workflow; scheduled on all 12 frozen datasets.<br>Host and viral features share one index, so host-virus ambiguity stays visible. | Not yet executed under the frozen protocol, so there is no eligible result for it. |
| ViralScan exact-fragment two-step | `W2_viralscan_two_step_star_exact_fragment` (secondary, 6 datasets) | Exact fragment lineage between the host-removal and viral steps. | Host reads are removed before viral alignment, so host-virus ambiguous reads are decided without the aligner seeing both (see the FAQ on combined versus two-step).<br>Not yet executed under the frozen protocol, so there is no eligible result for it. |
| STARsolo | `W3_starsolo_combined` (comparator, 6 datasets)<br>`W4_starsolo_host_filter_two_step` (comparator, 6 datasets) | Host and viral features share one index, so host-virus ambiguity stays visible. (`W3_starsolo_combined`) | Not yet executed under the frozen protocol, so there is no eligible result for it.<br>Host reads are removed before viral alignment, so host-virus ambiguous reads are decided without the aligner seeing both (see the FAQ on combined versus two-step). (`W4_starsolo_host_filter_two_step`) |
| Traditional host subtraction | `W5_traditional_subtraction_with_cb_umi` (comparator, 6 datasets)<br>`W6_traditional_subtraction_without_cb_umi` (comparator, 6 datasets) | Retains cell barcode and UMI, so per-cell molecule counts exist. (`W5_traditional_subtraction_with_cb_umi`) | Host reads are removed before viral alignment, so host-virus ambiguous reads are decided without the aligner seeing both (see the FAQ on combined versus two-step).<br>Not yet executed under the frozen protocol, so there is no eligible result for it.<br>Discards cell barcode and UMI, so it cannot give per-cell molecule counts. (`W6_traditional_subtraction_without_cb_umi`) |
| Dedicated viral scRNA-seq tools | `W7a_venus_native` (comparator, 6 datasets)<br>`W7b_venus_matched` (comparator, 6 datasets)<br>`W8a_viral_track_native` (comparator, 6 datasets)<br>`W8b_viral_track_matched` (comparator, 6 datasets)<br>`W9a_virtus_native` (comparator, 6 datasets)<br>`W9b_virtus_matched` (comparator, 6 datasets) | Native-published arm: measures the tool as its authors ship it. (`W7a_venus_native`, `W8a_viral_track_native`, `W9a_virtus_native`)<br>Run at published defaults, with no silent algorithm patch.<br>Matched-accession-index arm: shares viral sequences with ViralScan, the arm that carries cross-tool claims. (`W7b_venus_matched`, `W8b_viral_track_matched`, `W9b_virtus_matched`) | Native arm uses a different reference; its numbers may not share a table with matched-arm numbers without disclosure. (`W7a_venus_native`, `W8a_viral_track_native`, `W9a_virtus_native`)<br>Needs an isolated, digest-pinned third-party environment; failures are reported, not patched.<br>Not yet executed under the frozen protocol, so there is no eligible result for it. |

ViralScan 2.2.0 (`W10a_legacy_v2_native`, `W10b_legacy_v2_matched`) is a predecessor comparison, not a
workflow strategy, and is scored on its UMI-deduplicated unique-mapping layer only.
